facts.statement: A Farm update added a new farm (the Heather Wood farm, 'ferme du Bois des bruyères'), new items to keep farms in good condition, a new seed to grow, a boom box that makes plants dance, and other agriculture features; new quests and recipes for the new regions were also included.
facts.quote: il y a une nouvelle ferme (ferme du Bois des bruyères), de nouveaux objets pour aider à garder votre ferme en bon état, une nouvelle graine à cultiver, un boom box

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language producer letter from Harvey Burgess, introducing himself as Free Realms' new producer. It apologises for late membership packs (June and July updates), promises the August pack early in the month and future packs early each month, and announces a Farm update with a new farm, farm items, a new seed, a boom box and other farming features, with Ranching teased as upcoming. The page gives only a relative date ('il y a 1 année, 3 mois'), so the exact publication date is unknown.
